record.field: A spun-metal bell that pours light onto the table.

field.name: description_ecommerce
field.p: AUREL is spun from a single disc of brass, its tapered silhouette refined over forty prototypes until the edge became almost weightless. A recessed opal diffuser conceals the light source, sending a calm, glare-free pool of light down onto the table while the polished interior glows softly.

ul.li: Ø 420 mm × H 380 mm · Cable up to 3000 mm
Spun brass shade, opal glass diffuser, braided textile cable

field.name: description_ecommerce
field.p: VELA groups softly domed shades at staggered heights, like sails catching the evening light. Each dome is hand-finished and fitted with a satin-etched lens, creating overlapping pools of warm light over long tables and kitchen islands.

ul.li: Shade Ø 320 mm × H 260 mm · Linear canopy 1200 mm
Spun brass or steel shades, etched glass lens

record.field: A vertical blade of light that grazes the wall.

field.name: description_ecommerce
field.p: Named after the fabric dividers hung in Japanese doorways, NOREN is a slender vertical profile that washes light up and down the wall. It reveals texture in plaster, stone and timber while the fixture itself remains a thin, almost graphic line.

ul.li: W 60 mm × H 600 mm × D 45 mm
Extruded aluminium or solid brass, micro-prismatic lens

record.field: A balanced arc, drawn with a single line.

field.name: description_ecommerce
field.p: ELYS balances a deep, conical reflector on a slender steel stem anchored by a weighted base. The reflector pivots through 270°, turning from a focused reading light into an indirect uplight that softly bounces off the ceiling.

ul.li: H 1650 mm · Reflector Ø 260 mm · Base Ø 300 mm
Powder-coated steel, cast iron base, brass details

field.name: description_ecommerce
field.p: ORION arranges hand-blown glass spheres along balanced brass arms, each one counterweighted so the composition appears to float. Conceived for entrance halls, stairwells and grand dining rooms, it can be specified as a single piece or a multi-tier cluster.

ul.li: Ø 1100 mm × H 900 mm · Drop up to 4000 mm
Solid brass arms, mouth-blown glass spheres

record.field: A small sun at rest on a travertine base.

field.name: description_ecommerce
field.p: SOLEN pairs an opal glass globe with a turned travertine base. Switched on, the globe becomes a soft, uniform orb of light; switched off, it reads as a quiet still life on a sideboard, desk or bedside table.

ul.li: Mouth-blown opal glass, honed travertine, brass collar

record.field: A sweeping arc rising from a travertine block.

field.name: description_ecommerce
field.p: HALO lifts a softly glowing shade on a long, tensioned brass arc, anchored by a solid block of honed travertine. It brings overhead light into the centre of a room without a single ceiling connection.

ul.li: H 2100 mm · Reach 1800 mm · Base 300 × 300 mm
Brass arc, honed travertine base, linen shade

record.field: Layered rings that glow from within.

field.name: description_ecommerce
field.p: STRATA stacks three spun shades whose inner surfaces are finished in burnished copper, so each layer catches and colours the light before releasing it below. A sculptural focal point for dining rooms and double-height spaces.

ul.li: Spun bronze-finish shades, burnished copper interior

record.field: The essential pendant, reduced to a precise silhouette.

field.name: description_ecommerce
field.p: LUMA is our most essential pendant: a deep spun-aluminium shade with a fine rolled edge and a white interior that directs comfortable, glare-free light downward. Specified in rows above kitchen islands and workspace tables.

record.field: Globes of light orbiting a central ring.

field.name: description_ecommerce
field.p: CIELO arranges opal glass globes around a slim brass ring, each one floating at a slightly different height. The result is a soft, almost lunar light that brings calm to living rooms, libraries and hotel lounges.

ul.li: Brass ring, mouth-blown opal glass globes

record.field: A precise burst of light, frozen in brass.

field.name: description_ecommerce
field.p: ASTRA radiates slender brass rods from a central hub, each tipped with a small opal globe. Its geometry is mid-century in spirit yet resolved with contemporary LED engineering and a fully concealed driver.

ul.li: Solid brass rods, opal glass globes

record.field: A brass arm reaching out to frame a reading chair.

field.name: description_ecommerce
field.p: LIRA is an articulated wall sconce with a pivoting brass arm and a softly tapered shade. Mounted beside a bed or armchair, it brings light exactly where it is needed and folds flat against the wall when it is not.

field.name: description_ecommerce
field.p: DUNE sets a pleated linen shade on a sculpted travertine body whose curves recall wind-shaped sand. Its warm, diffused light is designed for bedside tables, hotel suites and quiet corners.

ul.li: Honed travertine body, pleated linen shade

record.field: A slender column with a tilting reflector.

field.name: description_ecommerce
field.p: PILAR is a reading lamp of almost structural clarity: a thin column, a counterbalanced head and a matte reflector that tilts through 90° to place light precisely onto the page.

record.field: A continuous line of light, integrated into the architecture.

field.name: description_ecommerce
field.p: LINEA is a recessed and surface-mounted linear system with a deep micro-prismatic optic, delivering seamless lines of glare-free light across ceilings, walls and joinery. Lengths are specified per project to the millimetre.

ul.li: Profile 35 × 70 mm · Lengths 300–6000 mm (per metre pricing)

record.field: Precision accent light on a minimal magnetic track.

field.name: description_ecommerce
field.p: AXIS is a 48 V magnetic track system with interchangeable spotlights, wall-washers and linear modules. Elements click into place anywhere along the track, so lighting can evolve as a gallery, shop or home changes.

ul.li: 10 W per spot · 2700 K / 3000 K / 4000 K · 900 lm per spot · CRI > 97

record.field: Light without a source: a deep, trimless recessed downlight.

field.name: description_ecommerce
field.p: NOVA sets its light source deep within a black honeycomb baffle so that the ceiling appears to glow without any visible fixture. Trimless plaster-in and slim-bezel versions allow it to disappear into any architecture.

ul.li: Ø 85 mm · Cut-out Ø 75 mm · Recess depth 95 mm

record.field: An opal cone, as simple as a drawn line.

field.name: description_ecommerce
field.p: KORA is a mouth-blown opal glass cone suspended from a fine cable. It diffuses light in every direction, filling a room with a gentle glow. It is beautiful alone above a bedside, or repeated in long rhythmic rows.

ul.li: Mouth-blown opal or smoked glass, aluminium canopy
